module: Flowgraph node 'Xor' (logic category). The flow goes out if exactly one of the two inputs a and b has flow.
notes: Compares the values with ~=: if one input is nil and the other false, the result is true (nil ~= false).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.
